SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LTCO') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY KEP_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT KEP_SEQ TRANSACTION_ID, BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, DATA01 AS REVISION_NO, DATA02 AS ADD_DATE, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, DATA03 AS TARGET_PRICE, UNIT_PRICE, DATA04 AS REQ_USER_ID, DATA05 AS REQ_USER_NAME, CATEGORY1, CATEGORY2, CATEGORY3, DELIVERY_LT, MIN_ORDER_QTY AS MOQ_QTY, PUR_UNIT_QTY AS UNIT_QTY, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, DATA08 AS CURRENCY, DATA06 AS ITEM_QTY, DATA07 AS REMARK, '' AS KEY_1, '' AS KEY_2, '' AS KEY_3, '' AS KEY_4, '' AS KEY_5 FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
